mara (docs): Quick heads-up — I'm opening a small docs PR to add a 'sealed bundle verification' section for the offline installer and a recommended systemd hook for the KMS agent. Need quick SME review before I merge. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4876
jaime (eng-install): Thanks — can you paste the checksum verification snippet here? I want to make sure it matches our `offline-sign` tool output.
samir (infra): Also flagging: if we recommend `sha256sum` in examples, include a note about using `openssl dgst -sha256` on busy distros that replace sha tools. Small compatibility callout.
mara (docs): Good call. Current snippet in the PR: ```bash
# generate local checksum
sha256sum sealed-bundle.tar.gz | awk '{print $1}'
# fetch canonical checksum from bundle server and compare
curl -sSfL https://artifacts.redwood-internal/sealed-bundles/2026-03-verify.sha256 | grep $(sha256sum sealed-bundle.tar.gz | awk '{print $1}')
```
mara (docs): And the systemd unit hook I'm proposing for the kms-agent (to run after network is ready and verify the bundle integrity at boot): ```ini
[Unit]
Description=Redwood KMS agent
After=network-online.target
Wants=network-online.target

[Service]
Type=simple
Environment=SEALED_BUNDLE=/opt/redwood/sealed-bundle.tar.gz
ExecStartPre=/bin/sh -c 'openssl dgst -sha256 "$SEALED_BUNDLE" | awk \"{print \$2}\" > /run/sealed-bundle.local.sha256'
ExecStartPre=/bin/sh -c 'curl -sSfL https://artifacts.redwood-internal/sealed-bundles/current.sha256 -o /run/sealed-bundle.canonical.sha256'
ExecStartPre=/bin/sh -c '[ \"$(cat /run/sealed-bundle.local.sha256)\" = \"$(cat /run/sealed-bundle.canonical.sha256)\" ] || (echo "sealed bundle mismatch" >&2; exit 1)'
ExecStart=/usr/bin/redwood-kms-agent --socket /var/run/redwood/kms.sock
Restart=on-failure

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
```
lina (security): Please make it explicit that the canonical checksum URL is only reachable from the airgapped sync host (not from customer networks). Add a short note about verifying fingerprint of the signing key before trusting the checksum file.
nate (support): One ask from support — add a troubleshooting line for the common failure: "sealed bundle mismatch" with quick steps: verify bundle transfer (rsync/scp), re-run `offline-sign`, check clocks.
jaime (eng-install): For HSM/KMS specifics: we should include the expected PKCS#11 path var in the unit (different on RHEL vs Debian). Suggest adding an env example: `PKCS11_LIB=/usr/lib64/pkcs11/softHSM2.so` and a one-liner to test with `p11tool` or `pkcs11-tool`.
mara (docs): Will add RHEL/Debian note and a tiny troubleshooting table. Lina — I'll add one sentence about pinning the signing key fingerprint and link to our key distribution page. Samir — can you confirm the canonical checksum host and path? I used `artifacts.redwood-internal/sealed-bundles/current.sha256` as a placeholder.
samir (infra): Confirmed — the internal host is `artifacts.redwood-internal` on the VPC and the sync service exposes `/<org>/sealed-bundles/<date>.sha256` plus a `current.sha256` symlink. I'll add an internal note for ops about TTLs and rotation. Also we should note that the sync host serves via HTTPS with mTLS in our private deploys — mention that curl must include `--cert` for some on-prem setups.
lina (security): Another security nit: update docs to recommend verifying the signing cert chain with the customer's root CA when running in an air-gapped environment. Provide the openssl commands.
mara (docs): I'll add a tiny "air-gapped checklist" section: 1) transfer sealed bundle via rsync/scp, 2) verify checksum, 3) verify signing cert, 4) load bundle, 5) start kms-agent. Will keep each line short with links to more detail (installer & key distribution).
